summary:
"Nine decisions, nine implemented as written. I verified every verdict against the diff itself rather than the run's records, and the records held up everywhere I could check them independently — including the ones easiest to fake: the glass consumer arithmetic (10 modules, 8 outside the sanctioned pair) checks out against a fresh grep; the LD-19 grep proof holds (every surviving `minmax(` in apps/web/src is the minmax(0,Nfr) idiom, the utility, R4's sanctioned site, or a comment); the website docs-dist really was re-synced and really does contain no state/*.html; root STATE.md really is untouched.

Seven decisions conform outright (LD-14, LD-15, LD-16, LD-18, LD-20, LD-21, and LD-22's substance). Three carry notes: LD-17 for an untested phone branch, LD-19 for a stylelint pattern narrower than its own decision text, LD-22 for annotating a pre-existing media block rather than adding one. No deviations — I hunted specifically for the failure modes named in the brief and found none of them. No harmonization of Browse and Watchlist (the divergence is asserted in three separate comments and proven by the restricted-zone safety test). No anti-enumeration behavior on /reset (the probe reuses the existing passwordReset bucket and answers byte-identical 404s across all four failure cases, proven at the wire in not-found-envelope.e2e.spec.ts). No facts beyond R2's set on the mini-cards. No display:none or visibility:hidden remnant for the PIN field — the media query is deleted outright and a test asserts the absence file-wide. No surviving ellipsis on the item-detail path. No code changes in glass.css or its consumers. No refactors of pre-existing mobile blocks for LD-21's convention. Zero new dependencies, zero new egress, zero Claude-Session lines.

The two findings I would actually act on: (1) the LD-19 stylelint rule requires a digit after `minmax(`, so `minmax(var(--grid-min-poster), 1fr)` — a token floor with the min() clamp omitted, which is the exact mistake this migration now makes likely — passes silently; (2) the LD-19 migration introduced a cross-stylesheet source-order dependency for three overrides that previously lived in the same file as their base, which is a durability regression sitting under a 'pixel-identical refactor' criterion. Both are recorded in NOTED.md, both were verified against a production build, neither blocks.

Two things genuinely must happen before close: run gate:full and refresh perf/web-budget-result.json (never measured against the new global stylesheet or the new client JS), and add one test covering the phone branch that f5f39ff introduced — currently the only branch in the run with implementation but no check, against a repo rule that forbids exactly that."
